Class ResearchProject

java.lang.Object
project.models.others.ResearchProject
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ResearchProject extends Object implements Serializable
A collaborative research project. Only users with researcher status (ResearcherDecorator) can participate or publish papers under it.
